name: get_party_member_position_z

stack.evidence: func_001D5E48 uses the top value to index the three-object party registry at D_002DEC00 and replaces it with the integer-converted position Z float at object offset 0x18

notes: This is the Z-coordinate counterpart of command 290 get_party_member_position_x and command 291, which reads object offset 0x14. A null party slot leaves the input value unchanged. All 171 JP calls pass slot 0 for the player; 162 are paired with command 290, and the remaining nine join commands 290 and 291 as an X/Y/Z position triple.
